messages.snippet: Alice, Priya, Attached is a first draft of the non-binding term sheet capturing the commercial shape
messages.subject: Project Cedar — draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Alice, Priya,

Attached is a first draft of the non-binding term sheet capturing the commercial shape we discussed: exclusive licence in the cosmetics/personal-care field, UK/EU/Switzerland/US territory, £1.75m upfront, up to £4.25m in milestones, and a 6% running royalty (4% for know-how-only sales), with minimum annual royalties stepping up to £600k.

The exclusivity, costs, confidentiality and governing-law paragraphs are drafted as binding; the rest is subject to contract. Once you're comfortable we'll send it to Verrell.

The 90-day exclusivity lock is worth having given they asked for it.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

From a finance perspective this looks right. The 6% headline is where we wanted to land; I'd expect Verrell to push us toward 5% so we have some room. Please make sure the £25m Net Sales milestone is clearly a one-off.

Happy for this to go across once Priya has done her pass.

Marcus Veldt
CFO, Larkmoor Bioscience

messages.subject: RE: Project Cedar — draft term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Marcus,

Two small points and then I'm happy: (1) please make explicit that all fields outside cosmetics/personal-care are reserved to us, including any future structural-materials work; (2) the reserved research right should let us keep collaborating with our academic partners. Otherwise content for it to go to Verrell.

Priya
